simple.meaning: מִגְרוֹן (Migrôwn) is a Hebrew word meaning “Migron , a place in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מִגְרוֹן (H4051) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 1 Samuel 14:2, with occurrences in 1 Samuel, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִגְרוֹן (H4051) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מִגְרוֹן (H4051) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מִגְרוֹן (Migrôwn) / H4051 is traced through 1 Samuel 14:2, Isaiah 10:28 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H4051. Migron מִגְרוֺן proper name, of a location 1. 1Sam 14:2 district (?) near Gibeah (home of Saul), compare Buhl Geogr. 176 ; ᵐ5 Μαγων , ᵐ5 L Μαγεδδω , (We thinks proper name not required, and proposes מִגְרָן (= גֹּרֶן ᵑ6 threshingfloor ; so Bu, but word not in Hebrew; Klo, improbable, מִגְרָשׁ ). 2 Isa 10:28 , place north of Michmash (and Gibeah ), ᵐ5 Μαγεδω , perhaps modern ruin Makrun Di on the passage Bd Pal 3. 121 Buhl l.c . מְגֵרָה see גרר . [ מִגְרָעָה ], מִגְרָעוֺת see גרע . [ מֶגְרָפָה ] see גרף . מִגְרָשׁ see גרשׁ . מַד see מדד . I, II. מִדְבָּר see דבר . below,

occurrences.englishText: Saul stayed in the uttermost part of Gibeah under the pomegranate tree which is in Migron: and the people who were with him were about six hundred men;
He has come to Aiath. He has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage.
